name: Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed
contribution: As Chief Justice, he accepted the opposition parties' nomination to lead the interim administration after President H. M. Ershad resigned in December 1990.
context: The anti-Ershad movement brought opposition parties, students, professionals, and civil-society actors together around a transition back to parliamentary democracy.
impact: His interim administration helped create the institutional bridge from the 1990 mass uprising to the 1991 parliamentary election and restoration of parliamentary government.

faq.question: How is Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed connected to the 1990 Mass Uprising?
faq.answer: Justice Shahabuddin Ahmed became Acting President and head of the first caretaker government after the opposition-backed transition of December 1990. His administration prepared the way for the 1991 return to parliamentary government.
